title: Comparison of Topical Treatment for Inflammatory Secretions of the Conjonctiva (Patients With Ocular Prostheses)
official: Comparison of Topical Hydrocortisone Versus Dexamethasone Treatment for Inflammatory Secretions of the Conjonctiva in Patients With Ocular Prostheses
summary: We propose to evaluate the efficacy of treatment with Hydrocortisone and Dexamethasone (in a cross-over design) in patients with ocular prostheses and significant functional discomfort.

sites.f: Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Rennes _ Pontchaillou
